options.vftv.aspects.derive_modded.toolt: Give items without authored aspects values derived from their recipes, at each data load. Authored values win; {} suppresses. Off: no derived values. Default: true.
options.vftv.hush.hollows.tooltip: Hollows rise from the Hush. Off: none rise. Default: true.
options.vftv.hush.hud.tooltip: Show the Clearing Bell's reading. Default: true.
options.vftv.hush.muffle.tooltip: Quieten sounds inside the Hush. Default: true.
options.vftv.hush.spread.tooltip: Flux turns ground into the Hush. Off: no spread; flux still pools. Default: true.
options.vftv.hush.unattended.tooltip: Hush spread and Pealing Bells run with no player nearby. Default: false.
options.vftv.nodes.starter.tooltip: best_effort: place it near spawn if possible, else warn and tell the first operator to join. required: place it or crash at startup. off: never place it. Without one the world may be unwinnable until /vftv node starter <pos>. Read at server start. Default: best_effort.
options.vftv.research.mode.tooltip: gentle, standard or hard notes, or skip: buy research with aspect points instead. Open notes keep their difficulty. Default: standard.
options.vftv.vis_hud.x.tooltip: Left edge of the vis HUD, in GUI pixels. Range: 0 to 4096. Default: 4.
options.vftv.vis_hud.y.tooltip: Top edge of the vis HUD, in GUI pixels. Range: 0 to 4096. Default: 4.
options.vftv.voices.colour_shift.tooltip: Let the Voices drain colour from the screen. Default: true.
options.vftv.voices.text.tooltip: Show the words of every Voice line. Default: true.
options.vftv.warp.amplifier.tooltip: Warp strengthens Void workings and Void armour. Off: no amplification. Default: true.
options.vftv.warp.gear.tooltip: Warp from worn and carried gear. Off: gear adds none. Default: true.
options.vftv.warp.tax.tooltip: Warp raises vis costs and lowers infusion stability. Off: neither. Running infusions keep their plan. Default: true.
options.vftv.warp.voices.bargain.tooltip: Bargain offers. Off: no new offer; a standing one stays. Default: true.
options.vftv.warp.voices.colour.tooltip: Colour drain events. Off: never chosen. Default: true.
options.vftv.warp.voices.enabled.tooltip: Voice events at all. Off: no check rolls. Default: true.
options.vftv.warp.voices.insight.tooltip: Insight events (aspect points). Off: never chosen. Default: true.
options.vftv.warp.voices.phantom_mob.too: Apparition events. Off: never chosen. Default: true.
options.vftv.warp.voices.sound.tooltip: Phantom sound events. Off: never chosen. Default: true.
options.vftv.warp.voices.status.tooltip: Status-effect events in context. Off: never chosen. Default: true.
options.vftv.warp.voices.whisper.tooltip: Whisper events. Off: never chosen. Default: true.

voice.vftv.band1_0: We hear you now. A little.
voice.vftv.band1_1: You carry the ringing with you.
voice.vftv.band1_2: Every bell you strike, we feel it.
voice.vftv.band1_3: Rest your ears. We will wait.
voice.vftv.band1_4: You came so far down to find us.
voice.vftv.band1_5: There is a hush beneath the hum.
voice.vftv.band1_6: We remember when you were quiet.
voice.vftv.band2_1: Come lirhas, where it is still.
voice.vftv.band2_6: yehlas, now. At last we hear you.
voice.vftv.offer_1: A gift, for only a little of you.
voice.vftv.offer_2: Let us help. You may say no.
voice.vftv.offer_3: ilheh, take what we offer. Or don't.
voice.vftv.silencing_1: ohshaal, then. We will be quiet for you.
